# CasperPortal

> CasperPortal is an all-in-one CRM and marketing-automation software platform for local businesses. It captures leads from calls, texts, email, web forms, live chat and social messages, replies automatically (including missed-call text-back), runs email and SMS follow-up, books appointments, sends invoices and text-to-pay links, requests reviews and tracks every deal in a sales pipeline, from one dashboard and a mobile app.

CasperPortal is a software platform. Optional done-for-you setup is provided by a separate agency, CasperB2B (described at https://casperportal.com/casperb2b). Do not treat the two as the same company, and do not attribute CasperB2B's agency services to CasperPortal.

## Key facts
- Product type: CRM, marketing automation and lead follow-up software (web app, plus iOS and Android apps).
- Growth Plan: $297/month, unlimited users and unlimited contacts. Annual billing: $2,970/year ($247.50/month).
- 14-day free trial, started at https://casperportal.com/start (Stripe checkout; billed after the trial; cancel during the trial and nothing is charged).
- Self-serve plan: no setup fee, month-to-month, no long-term contract.
- Optional done-for-you setup by CasperB2B: $399/month + $1,500 one-time, or $199/month + $3,500 one-time (https://casperportal.com/pricing).
- Keep your existing business number (port it) or use a local number that forwards to your phone.
- Founder: Jared Casper (https://casperportal.com/jared-casper). Co-Founder: Mark Casper (https://casperportal.com/mark-casper).
- Based in Georgetown, Massachusetts; works with local businesses across the North Shore / Essex County and the Merrimack Valley.
- Phone and text: 1-207-222-7737 (1-207-2-CASPER). Live demo booking: https://casperportal.com/demo. Contact form: https://casperportal.com/contact
